cautions: Stats describe initial forms, not every armor/airborne/exposure state.
Handlers, contact callbacks and damage modifiers can override matrix defaults.
CSV damage_to_org means damage to player/weapon side; damage_to_tgt means damage to enemy.
Only handler=default cells are direct generic damage values; numeric handlers require code review.
No implicit conversion from raw HP 255 to a damage-sponge enemy is valid.
Historical tiers are provenance, not a new hard difficulty or progression gate.

verification_obligations: An enum, string or catalogue entry does not count as a completed mechanic.
Every item has obtainable, usable, pickup/drop, save/load and new-run paths.
Every enemy has real movement, attacks, damage, counters, weaknesses, visible art and resource admission.
Every event/quest has a gameplay entry, success, failure/reset, reward and save/re-entry path.
Every directed graph link matches actual tiles, input transitions and destinations.
Profile migration preserves discoveries, appearance, original music and completed-run handling.
Run host checks and seed proofs plus native emulator inputs, screenshots and performance scenarios.

reference_only_or_user_override.bomb_fuse_150_frames: Superseded by current charge-and-throw ground-impact bombs.

kinstone_reference.world_event_ids: KinstoneId0..100 identify original world events, not101 distinct reusable item shapes. Keep matching half shapes separate from event IDs.
kinstone_reference.cloud_top_five: Original Cloud Tops keys1..5 refer to Nintendo world progression, not additional required original-game area content absent corresponding generated gates.
kinstone_reference.ordinary_halves: Red, blue and green families plus matching shapes; generator assigns original gate events and consumes compatible halves.

restoration_statuses.reference_exempt: Source format, excluded/raw form, future unnamed area or research proposal; retained as provenance, not a missing runtime feature.
restoration_statuses.retired_exempt: Explicitly retired source event; retained in ledger without reintroducing it.
restoration_statuses.baseline_retained_pending_native: Existing selected implementation remains connected; final integrated native preservation check pending.
restoration_statuses.code_connected_pending_native: Executable code and reachable caller/entry exist; this is not an emulator-complete claim.
restoration_statuses.host_logic_qualified_pending_native: Actual C logic has host qualification; native integrated behavior still has its own acceptance obligation.
restoration_statuses.host_geometry_qualified_pending_native: Actual room builder/route geometry passes host collision and component checks; native traversal still needs confirmation.
restoration_statuses.partial_runtime: Some real behavior exists, but a named acceptance detail is not yet implemented or qualified.
restoration_statuses.pending_performance_qualification: Budget code exists; final mixed-scene native cycle/OAM/palette/stream/audio qualification pending.
restoration_statuses.pending_art_qualification: Original native artwork is connected; final palette/coverage/animation/preservation audit pending.
restoration_statuses.native_sample_qualified: Actual mGBA input/state/PPU evidence qualifies the stated scenario and disclosed fixtures; it does not claim all seeds or source-bit-identical behavior.

restoration_review.mode: Concurrent implementation reconciliation; code-connected and host-qualified never imply final native completion.
